articles.fullText:
In September 2026, researchers from Beijing Foreign Studies University and the University of Göttingen published a study showing how TikTok has become a popular platform for learning Chinese, with the hashtag #LearnChinese surpassing 5 billion views.
Titled "From short videos to global learning: A data-driven analysis of the ecosystem of Chinese language learning on TikTok," the study analyzed 75,188 Chinese-learning videos and found that such content is increasingly interactive and entertainment-oriented, often blending language learning with cultural experiences.
For many learners, the classroom is no longer the only place to explore Chinese.
Chinese songs, cultural references and playful online challenges are sparking interest in Chinese among people around the world on social media. What might once have seemed difficult – from pinyin and tones to Chinese characters and grammar – has become a source of entertainment and interaction on social media.
In spring 2025, a wave of Mandarin pronunciation challenges swept across TikTok. In the challenge, people tried to pronounce Chinese words correctly to advance to the next round. The words ranged from animal names and fruits to popular Chinese expressions.
A participant in one video struggled through multiple attempts to pronounce Xiongmao, the Chinese word for panda, sparking discussion in the comments about Mandarin pronunciation and how to master its tones. The video received more than 400,000 likes.
Chinese music has also found an enthusiastic audience online. In early 2026, a video of an elderly Chinese woman joyfully singing Yue Lai Yue Hao (Getting Better and Better) went viral on TikTok. The lyrics celebrate improvements in everyday life, with lines about bigger homes, higher incomes and better working conditions. Her lively performance and the song's catchy melody helped the video gain attention, prompting other users to share their own versions.
The popularity of such videos is reflected in the geographic spread of Chinese-learning content.
According to the study, the top 5 countries and regions by the number of Chinese-learning videos posted on TikTok were South Korea, the United States, Vietnam, Indonesia and Japan. The list highlights the strong presence of Asian countries alongside the English-speaking country.
Everyday experiences inspire interest in Chinese
Ordering food and drinks in Chinese, for example, has become an opportunity for cross-cultural exchange as more international visitors travel to China.
According to China's National Immigration Administration, border authorities recorded 23.27 million cross-border trips by foreign nationals in the third quarter of 2026, up 15.6% year on year. As international travel to China grows, visitors are increasingly encountering the language in restaurants, shops and everyday interactions.
A South Korean user shared an amusing experience on X in February after ordering milk tea in China. The user said that some tea shops gave their drinks names that sounded like poetry, citing "on the way back to Yunnan, clouds hang low" as an example. The phrase was a playful rendering of Gui Yunnan Yun Man Pu'er, the name of a milk tea made with Pu'er tea, a specialty of Yunnan Province.
The post prompted discussion, with one commenter saying that such distinctive Chinese-style expressions made ordering drinks an enjoyable experience in itself.
For some, this curiosity is inspiring more structured language study. Duolingo, a language-learning platform, ranked Mandarin as the eighth most popular language on its platform in its 2025 Language Report.
Interest is growing across South America, Asia and Europe. Mandarin was the fastest-growing language on Duolingo in 12 countries in 2025, including Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, France, Germany, Indonesia, Mexico, Poland, South Korea, Spain, Thailand and Türkiye.

articles.title: China warns sidelining development undermines human rights
articles.titleCn: 中国警告：将发展边缘化会损害人权
articles.summary: China on Friday called for stronger international cooperation to advance the right to development, and urged countries to put development at the center of the global agenda amid widening inequalities and mounting challenges facing developing nations.
articles.summaryCn: 中国在联合国呼吁国际社会加强合作，将发展置于全球议程中心，警告发展被政治化和边缘化会损害人权，并提出四项建议以推进发展权。

paragraphs.en:
A file photo of China's Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations Sun Lei speaking at a United Nations Security Council meeting. China on Friday called for stronger international cooperation to {{2}} the right to development, urging countries to put development at the center of the global agenda amid {{3}} inequalities and {{4}} challenges facing developing nations. Speaking at a side event marking the 40th anniversary of the UN Declaration on the Right to Development, Sun Lei, China's deputy permanent representative to the United Nations, said that "only through continuous development can people's {{5}} for a better life and social stability be realized."
He warned that development has been {{6}} and pushed to the {{7}} when it is needed most, while divisions and {{8}} are being fueled when {{9}} is more critical than ever. Sun put forward four proposals to advance the right to development: defending the right to development, {{10}} development partnerships, improving the development environment, and fostering new drivers of growth. "The rights to {{11}} and development are basic human rights of {{12}} importance," he said, adding that equal importance should be placed on all human rights.
paragraphs.cn: 中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊在联合国安理会会议上的资料照片。周五，中国呼吁加强国际合作以推进发展权，敦促各国在发展中国家面临日益扩大的不平等和严峻挑战之际，将发展置于全球议程的中心。在纪念《联合国发展权利宣言》40周年的边会上，中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊表示，“只有通过不断发展，人民对美好生活和社会稳定的愿望才能实现。”他警告说，在发展最需要的时候，发展却被政治化并推向边缘，而在团结比以往任何时候都更加关键的时候，分歧和对抗却在被煽动。孙磊提出了推进发展权的四项建议：捍卫发展权、重振发展伙伴关系、改善发展环境、培育新的增长动力。他说：“生存权和发展权是首要的基本人权”，并补充说应同等重视所有人权。

paragraphs.en:
"Without development, there would be no human rights to speak of, nor could any enjoyment of rights be {{13}}," he said. "Development should be put front and center on the international agenda."
Sun also called for a more just and {{14}} international economic and financial {{15}}. "Unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction are {{17}} to development and must be rejected," he said, urging the international community to promote "an {{18}} economic globalization that benefits all."
On innovation, Sun called for speeding up technology transfer and knowledge sharing to close the digital and AI divides and to accelerate the low-carbon transition. Sun said China's Global Development Initiative (GDI) has {{19}} more than $23 billion in funding and supported over 1,800 "small and beautiful" projects, benefiting local communities in more than 120 countries. "China stands ready to work with all parties to strengthen international cooperation and create an {{20}} environment for the realization of the right to development," Sun said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：“没有发展，就谈不上人权，任何权利的享有也无法持续。”“发展应被置于国际议程的最前沿和中心。”孙磊还呼吁建立更加公正和公平的国际经济和金融架构。他说：“单边制裁和长臂管辖不利于发展，必须予以拒绝”，并敦促国际社会推动“惠及所有人的包容性经济全球化”。关于创新，孙磊呼吁加快技术转让和知识共享，以缩小数字和人工智能鸿沟，并加速低碳转型。孙磊表示，中国的全球发展倡议（GDI）已动员超过230亿美元资金，支持了1800多个“小而美”项目，惠及120多个国家的当地社区。孙磊说：“中国愿与各方一道，加强国际合作，为实现发展权创造有利环境。”

paragraphs.en: The event was co-organized by the Permanent Mission of China to the UN, the Coordinating Bureau of the Non-Aligned Movement and the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights. Godfrey Kwoba, charge d'affaires of Uganda's UN mission and chair of the Coordinating Bureau of the Non-Aligned Movement, said the principles in the declaration must be translated into practical policies and actions at national, regional and international levels. Claudia Fuentes Julio, UN assistant secretary-general for human rights, said development is not simply about economic growth; it is also about ensuring the benefits of development are shared fairly and equitably. Bjorg Sandkjaer, UN assistant secretary-general for policy coordination, welcomed the GDI as a contribution to global development efforts. She said the emphasis on prioritizing development, adopting a people-centered approach and promoting practical cooperation is closely aligned with the right to development and the 2030 Agenda.
paragraphs.cn: 此次活动由中国常驻联合国代表团、不结盟运动协调局和联合国人权事务高级专员办事处共同举办。乌干达常驻联合国代表团临时代办、不结盟运动协调局主席戈弗雷·夸巴表示，宣言中的原则必须在国家、区域和国际层面转化为切实的政策和行动。联合国负责人权事务的助理秘书长克劳迪娅·富恩特斯·胡利奥表示，发展不仅仅是经济增长，还关乎确保发展成果得到公平和公正的分享。联合国负责政策协调的助理秘书长比约格·桑克亚尔欢迎全球发展倡议对全球发展努力的贡献。她说，强调优先发展、采取以人为本的方式和促进务实合作与发展权和2030年议程高度一致。

paragraphs.en: Adopted by the UN General Assembly in 1986, the Declaration on the Right to Development recognizes development as an {{21}} human right, {{22}} that every person and all peoples are entitled to participate in, contribute to, and enjoy development.
paragraphs.cn: 《发展权利宣言》由联合国大会于1986年通过，承认发展是一项不可剥夺的人权，申明每个人和所有民族都有权参与、促进和享受发展。

articles.fullText:
A file photo of China's Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations Sun Lei speaking at a United Nations Security Council meeting. 
China on Friday called for stronger international cooperation to advance the right to development, urging countries to put development at the center of the global agenda amid widening inequalities and mounting challenges facing developing nations.
Speaking at a side event marking the 40th anniversary of the UN Declaration on the Right to Development, Sun Lei, China's deputy permanent representative to the United Nations, said that "only through continuous development can people's aspirations for a better life and social stability be realized."
He warned that development has been politicized and pushed to the margins when it is needed most, while divisions and confrontation are being fueled when solidarity is more critical than ever.
Sun put forward four proposals to advance the right to development: defending the right to development, reinvigorating development partnerships, improving the development environment, and fostering new drivers of growth.
"The rights to subsistence and development are basic human rights of paramount importance," he said, adding that equal importance should be placed on all human rights.
"Without development, there would be no human rights to speak of, nor could any enjoyment of rights be sustainable," he said. "Development should be put front and center on the international agenda."
Sun also called for a more just and equitable international economic and financial architecture.
"Unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction are inimical to development and must be rejected," he said, urging the international community to promote "an inclusive economic globalization that benefits all."
On innovation, Sun called for speeding up technology transfer and knowledge sharing to close the digital and AI divides and to accelerate the low-carbon transition.
Sun said China's Global Development Initiative (GDI) has mobilized more than $23 billion in funding and supported over 1,800 "small and beautiful" projects, benefiting local communities in more than 120 countries.
"China stands ready to work with all parties to strengthen international cooperation and create an enabling environment for the realization of the right to development," Sun said.
The event was co-organized by the Permanent Mission of China to the UN, the Coordinating Bureau of the Non-Aligned Movement and the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.
Godfrey Kwoba, charge d'affaires of Uganda's UN mission and chair of the Coordinating Bureau of the Non-Aligned Movement, said the principles in the declaration must be translated into practical policies and actions at national, regional and international levels.
Claudia Fuentes Julio, UN assistant secretary-general for human rights, said development is not simply about economic growth; it is also about ensuring the benefits of development are shared fairly and equitably.
Bjorg Sandkjaer, UN assistant secretary-general for policy coordination, welcomed the GDI as a contribution to global development efforts.
She said the emphasis on prioritizing development, adopting a people-centered approach and promoting practical cooperation is closely aligned with the right to development and the 2030 Agenda.
Adopted by the UN General Assembly in 1986, the Declaration on the Right to Development recognizes development as an inalienable human right, affirming that every person and all peoples are entitled to participate in, contribute to, and enjoy development.

中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊在联合国安理会会议上的资料照片。周五，中国呼吁加强国际合作以推进发展权，敦促各国在发展中国家面临日益扩大的不平等和严峻挑战之际，将发展置于全球议程的中心。在纪念《联合国发展权利宣言》40周年的边会上，中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊表示，“只有通过不断发展，人民对美好生活和社会稳定的愿望才能实现。”他警告说，在发展最需要的时候，发展却被政治化并推向边缘，而在团结比以往任何时候都更加关键的时候，分歧和对抗却在被煽动。孙磊提出了推进发展权的四项建议：捍卫发展权、重振发展伙伴关系、改善发展环境、培育新的增长动力。他说：“生存权和发展权是首要的基本人权”，并补充说应同等重视所有人权。

articles.fullText:
The vast two-thirds of the ocean beyond national jurisdiction has been hit by overfishing, shipping traffic and plastic pollution, while emerging threats like deep-sea mining and marine carbon dioxide removal proposals loom on the horizon. Although already subject to international law, there was no global framework to protect these waters. With the UN High Seas Treaty (formally known as the Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction, or BBNJ, Agreement) entering into force on January 17, 2026, a new legal framework for conserving and sustainably using marine biodiversity in these shared waters is in place.
Colorful coral reefs. 
At the UN biodiversity summit (COP17) in Yerevan, Armenia, this week, experts met to figure out how different global rules can work together to save the ocean.
The Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) is the broad framework for biodiversity conservation. Its Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework sets a target to ensure that, by 2030, at least 30% of the world's terrestrial and inland water areas, as well as coastal and marine areas, are effectively conserved and managed.
The BBNJ Agreement complements it by establishing rules for conserving and sustainably using marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction. It covers everything from marine genetic resources and how to share their benefits in a fair and equitable manner to area-based management tools, including marine protected areas, environmental impact assessments, capacity-building and marine technology transfer. These measures are designed to strengthen international cooperation and support developing countries in implementing the agreement.
The coastal view of Xiamen, Fujian Province, southeast China. 
China played a key role in the negotiations and ratified the treaty on December 15, 2025, becoming one of its first Parties. Now, Beijing has thrown its weight behind Xiamen, in Fujian province, to host the treaty's secretariat. Brussels and Valparaiso are also in the running, with the final decision set for January 2027. To help developing countries participate in the process, China has pledged $3 million to a voluntary trust fund.
Meanwhile, seven West African countries, led by Nigeria, are working to advance a proposal for a highly and fully protected marine protected area in the Guinea–Canary Currents Convergence Zone. At COP17 on October 26, Nigeria outlined the initiative, which is being developed through the West Africa BBNJ Coordination Committee. The intitiative demonstrates the need for scientific cooperation, data-sharing, monitoring and enforcement, sustainable financing and support for coastal livelihoods.
Pointe des Almadies, Senegal, the westernmost point of mainland Africa. 
Turning such proposals into effective protection will require reliable scientific data. Deep-sea surveys, biodiversity monitoring, satellite observations and vessel-tracking data can help identify ecologically important habitats, establish baselines and inform marine protected area planning on the high seas. Environmental impact assessments can also help evaluate the potential risks of human activity to vulnerable ecosystems.
Although the CBD and the BBNJ Agreement operate under separate frameworks, closer coordination is essential. Delivering the 2030 targets will require international rules to be backed by reliable science, technical capacity and sustained cooperation.

articles.fullText:
China on Thursday strongly condemned and firmly opposed the United States' decision to add three Chinese entities to the so-called "Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List," accusing Washington of using human rights as a pretext to suppress Chinese businesses and pursue unilateral protectionism.
There is no forced labor in China, and people of all ethnic groups in Xinjiang enjoy freedom and equality in employment, with their labor rights and interests effectively protected by law, a spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce said in response to the US Department of Homeland Security's announcement that it had added three Chinese entities to the list.
The US measures have no factual basis, the spokesperson said, accusing the US side of persistently manipulating human rights issues to pursue unilateral protectionism and bullying under the guise of human rights protection.
The spokesperson noted that the United States had recently added a large number of Chinese entities to the same list. China had lodged solemn representations with the US side and taken resolute countermeasures.
Disregarding China's firm opposition, the United States has continued to impose new sanctions, this time targeting Chinese biomedical technology companies, the spokesperson said.
Such actions run counter to the consensus reached by the two heads of state, seriously undermine the stability of China-US economic and trade relations, and run counter to humanitarian principles, the spokesperson added.
The spokesperson urged the United States to immediately stop its political manipulation and smear campaigns and cease its unjustified suppression of Chinese companies, adding that China will take necessary measures to resolutely safeguard its own interests.
Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun also reiterated Beijing's opposition to the US decision at a regular press conference on Thursday, accusing Washington of repeatedly spreading what China describes as false allegations concerning Xinjiang and using claims of forced labor as a pretext to target Chinese enterprises.
Guo said the allegations of forced labor were a century-old lie fabricated by anti-China forces, aimed at destabilizing Xinjiang, smearing China and containing its development.
China urged the United States to stop interfering in China's internal affairs and seeking to contain its development under the guise of human rights, Guo said, adding that China would take necessary measures to resolutely safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

发言人表示，美方无视中方的坚决反对，继续实施新的制裁，此次针对的是中国生物医药技术企业。此类行为违背了两国元首达成的共识，严重破坏了中美经贸关系的稳定，也违背了人道主义原则，发言人补充道。发言人敦促美国立即停止政治操弄和抹黑运动，停止对中国企业的无理打压，并补充说中国将采取必要措施坚决维护自身利益。中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆也在周四的例行记者会上重申了北京对美国决定的反对，指责华盛顿反复散布中国所称的关于新疆的虚假指控，并利用强迫劳动的说法作为针对中国企业的借口。郭嘉昆表示，强迫劳动指控是反华势力编造的世纪谎言，旨在破坏新疆稳定、抹黑中国、遏制中国发展。

郭嘉昆表示，中国敦促美国停止干涉中国内政，停止以人权为幌子寻求遏制中国发展，并补充说中国将采取必要措施坚决维护中国企业的合法权益。

articles.fullText:
Russia plans to hold trilateral talks with Ukraine in Abu Dhabi in November under US mediation, with the meeting seen as having "decisive significance" for resolving the Ukraine conflict, Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said on Friday, according to Russia's state-run news agency RIA Novosti.
Moscow and Washington have begun coordinating the date of the talks, but no final decision has been made, Ushakov said, adding that the timing would depend on various domestic and international factors.
Asked about the possible presence of European representatives, Ushakov said they would not take part in the trilateral talks, even if they met with Ukrainian or US officials.
Ushakov previously said the trilateral meeting would take place after November 4.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Wednesday that he hoped the meeting would take place between November 6 and 10. Kyiv also wanted Europe to be involved in discussions on ending the war, he said.
Military confrontation continues
Preparations for trilateral talks do not imply any commitment to limiting military operations, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Friday.
"We have repeatedly stated that we are against a ceasefire that would give the Ukrainians a respite," Peskov said.
Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov also said on Friday that Moscow's position on the Ukraine conflict remained unchanged.
Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of a G20 meeting in Atlanta, Lavrov said fundamental issues in relations between Russia and the United States remained unresolved, citing continued sanctions against Moscow and the supply of weapons to Kyiv.
The US State Department said on Friday it had approved the sale of 500 Patriot Advanced Capability-3 (PAC-3) Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) missiles and related equipment to Ukraine, valued at $2.1 billion.
The proposed sale also includes classified and unclassified spare parts, as well as logistical and program support, the department said.
The purchase will be financed through contributions from Canada, Germany and Norway under the JUMPSTART program, as well as national funds backed by the European Union's Ukraine Support Loan. No US funds will be used for the purchase, according to the department.
Zelenskyy said on social media that Ukraine had set key priorities for the further use of its long-range strike capabilities and would expand its deep-strike units.
He said every Russian strike on Ukrainian cities and communities would receive what he called "a fully justified response."

据俄罗斯国有新闻机构俄新社报道，克里姆林宫助理尤里·乌沙科夫周五表示，俄罗斯计划于11月在美国斡旋下在阿布扎比与乌克兰举行三方会谈，此次会议被视为对解决乌克兰冲突具有“决定性意义”。乌沙科夫说，莫斯科和华盛顿已开始协调会谈日期，但尚未做出最终决定，并补充说时间将取决于各种国内和国际因素。当被问及欧洲代表可能出席的问题时，乌沙科夫表示，即使他们与乌克兰或美国官员会面，也不会参加三方会谈。乌沙科夫此前曾表示，三方会议将在11月4日之后举行。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基周三表示，他希望会议在11月6日至10日之间举行。

他说，基辅也希望欧洲参与结束战争的讨论。军事对抗仍在继续。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周五表示，三方会谈的筹备工作并不意味着承诺限制军事行动。佩斯科夫说：“我们已多次表示，我们反对让乌克兰人获得喘息机会的停火。”俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫周五也表示，莫斯科在乌克兰冲突上的立场保持不变。拉夫罗夫在亚特兰大二十国集团会议间隙对记者说，俄罗斯与美国关系中的根本问题仍未解决，并提到继续对莫斯科实施制裁以及向基辅供应武器。

美国国务院周五表示，已批准向乌克兰出售500枚爱国者先进能力-3（PAC-3）导弹分段增强型（MSE）导弹及相关设备，价值21亿美元。国务院表示，拟议的军售还包括机密和非机密备件，以及后勤和项目支持。此次采购将通过加拿大、德国和挪威在JUMPSTART计划下的捐款以及欧盟乌克兰支持贷款支持的国家资金来融资。据国务院称，此次采购不会使用任何美国资金。泽连斯基在社交媒体上表示，乌克兰已为其远程打击能力的进一步使用设定了关键优先事项，并将扩大其深度打击部队。

他说，俄罗斯对乌克兰城市和社区的每一次袭击都将得到他所谓的“完全正当的回应”。
